summary: encrypt_string outputs an !vault block you paste into YAML inventory group or host vars; INI doesn't support inline vaults, so put them in YAML host_vars/group_vars or vars files.
questions: How do I put a vaulted password in my inventory?
Can I use inline vault values in an INI inventory?

answer_card.title: Use inline vault values
answer_card.answer_md:
Paste the output into a YAML inventory:
```yaml
vyos:
  vars:
    ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
    ansible_network_os: vyos.vyos.vyos
    ansible_user: my_vyos_user
    ansible_password: !vault |
      $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.2;AES256;my_user
      6638613465...
```
INI inventories don't support inline vaults. Put the value in a YAML file in `host_vars/` or `group_vars/`, or load it with `vars_files`/`include_vars`.
